shared_contracts.silent_pre_numeral: Visible quantity model is always available for requested count/transfer. Record representation; it is not independent spoken-number or numeral recognition. Model never contains an assessed joined/remainder answer.

shared_contracts.counts: Move/return/Undo may speak only the actual current basket count in counting and friend-plate count during transfer, including zero and overshoot six.
